# Trump waives Jones Act to ease oil crunch
President Trump issued a **[60-day waiver of the Jones](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0bf4b0-fa0a-4fdd-b746-379222ced6dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Act on March 18, allowing foreign vessels to ship oil and energy products between U.S. ports amid disruptions from the Iran war and Strait of Hormuz closure, aiming to stabilize surging prices as Brent hit $107 per barrel.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0bf4b0-fa0a-4fdd-b746-379222ced6dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Temporary Jones Act Waiver** : The 60-day suspension targets oil, natural gas, fertilizer, and coal transport to counter supply shocks from Middle East conflict and infrastructure attacks, though experts say impact on gas prices may be limited.
* **Oil Market Turmoil Drives Move** : Brent crude rose 3.83% to $107.38 and U.S. oil to $96.32 amid Strait of Hormuz threats, prompting the White House to act despite opposition from maritime unions over security concerns.
* **Trump Frustrated With Allies** : The president criticized U.S. allies for not securing the strait, highlighting the waiver as a step to ensure domestic resource flow without full repeal of the 1920 law.
* **Limited Refinery Benefits Expected** : Waiver enables more international tankers but faces constraints from U.S. refineries' mismatch with domestic shale oil, unlikely to significantly lower pump prices.

# Fed holds rates steady amid Iran War
The Federal Reserve **[kept the federal funds rate at 3.5%-3.75%](https://substack.com/redirect/43bf14ea-b29b-469e-9f5f-b6781dc0b31d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on March 18, projecting one rate cut in 2026 as the Iran war boosts inflation uncertainty and oil prices, while raising 2026 GDP growth to 2.4% and PCE inflation to 2.7%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43bf14ea-b29b-469e-9f5f-b6781dc0b31d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dot Plot Maintains One Cut** : Median forecast holds for a single 0.25% reduction in 2026, with more participants expecting no cuts amid uncertain Middle East impacts on inflation.
* **Higher Growth Inflation Outlook** : 2026 GDP projection up to 2.4%, unemployment steady at 4.4%, but headline and core PCE inflation raised to 2.7% due to oil supply disruptions.
* **Powell Cites Oil Price Risks** : Fed Chair noted rising near-term inflation expectations from Middle East oil shocks, calling it "too soon" to gauge full economic effects.
* **Market Reaction Turns Negative** : Stocks fell as decision dashed hopes for multiple cuts, with focus shifting to persistent inflation threats from the conflict.

# Rent prices plunge in the Sun Belt
U.S. median asking rent[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/b60a4a77-1da5-42b8-810a-1bb6396df37a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[fell to a four-year low in February 2026,](https://substack.com/redirect/b60a4a77-1da5-42b8-810a-1bb6396df37a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Sun Belt markets like Austin seeing an 18.2% drop from pandemic peaks as national rents declined for the 30th straight month to $1,667.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b60a4a77-1da5-42b8-810a-1bb6396df37a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Austin Leads Sharp Declines** : Median asking rent down 18.2% from peak and 7.1% year-over-year, driven by post-pandemic supply increases in high-growth areas.
* **15 Markets Down 10% Plus** : Cities including Birmingham (17.1%), Memphis (16.1%), and Phoenix (15.6%) from peaks show significant renter relief in the Sun Belt.
* **National Trend Persists** : Rents dropped $29 (1.7%) year-over-year, 5.1% from 2022 summer high but still 14.2% above pre-pandemic, per Realtor.com February data.
* **All 50 Metros Below Peaks** : Continued 30-month decline reflects increased apartment supply and cooling demand in formerly hot rental markets.

# Uber invests $1.25B in Rivian
Uber committed up to **[$1.25 billion in Rivian to expand its robotaxi fleet](https://substack.com/redirect/28cce9f0-8f38-4245-ab71-c2b0e5e7bc95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by up to 50,000 vehicles, starting with 10,000 Rivian R2 autonomous units in San Francisco and Miami by 2028.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/28cce9f0-8f38-4245-ab71-c2b0e5e7bc95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Major Fleet Expansion Deal** : Initial $300 million investment, with options for 40,000 more vehicles by 2030, using Rivian's in-house autonomous tech.
* **Deployment Timeline Set** : Rollout begins in San Francisco and Miami in 2028, scaling to 25 cities by 2031 for broader robotaxi network growth.
* **Rivian R2 Robotaxis Featured** : Vehicles leverage Rivian's RAP1 inference platform and multi-modal perception for full autonomy on Uber's platform.
* **Market Reaction Mixed** : Rivian shares surged over 10% on the news, while Uber dipped slightly amid focus on capital-intensive AV strategy.

All 50 Metros Below Peaks : Continued 30-month decline reflects increased apartment supply and cooling demand in formerly hot rental markets. Rivian R2 Robotaxis Featured : Vehicles leverage Rivian's RAP1 inference platform and multi-modal perception for full autonomy on Uber's platform. body:
In an increasingly digital world, how much time should students actually spend on screens in classrooms?

| | | | | [|
---](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=7ace651d87&e=3cf484ad56)
| | | | | | Peter,
I wanted to share a piece that I wrote for the L.A. Daily News, which came out this week: [**The case for limiting screen time in our schools.**](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=5323f8fc4d&e=3cf484ad56)
When the COVID-19 pandemic hit LAUSD, we took bold action by sending every student home with a device. At the time, it was a lifeline that kept students connected and learning.
When students returned to campuses, LAUSD rarely asked the question of whether or not these devices were still necessary. And research raises real concerns about excessive screen use for children, even as some schools have been able to use it as a helpful supplement to instructional activity.
That’s why, after leading the effort to ban cell phones in Los Angeles Unified schools last year, I’m now asking a more difficult question: **in an increasingly digital world, how much time should students actually spend on screens in classrooms?**
For these reasons I brought forward a resolution directing the district to develop a clear policy informed by research, best practices, and expert input. The goal is to establish developmentally appropriate guidelines that balance access to technology with the kinds of instruction and interaction we know help students thrive.
If enacted, my resolution could lead to LAUSD being the first district in our nation to establish comprehensive, developmentally grounded screen time limits in schools, setting a new standard for responsible technology policy in public education.
[Will you chip in today to help limit screen time in schools?](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=3b1cfe123b&e=3cf484ad56)

body:
It’s important that you don’t believe everything you see at first glance.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2971%2E21716%2ErHWJMd)
Hi, it's Sarah.
I wanted to give you a warning that there’s been a spike in AI slop about me online lately, including fake images and completely fabricated quotes, often about gender.
They pop up in your social media feeds from “content farms” and can sometimes even seem innocuous. But in reality, they’re meant to foster division and spread false information and inaccurate perceptions.
And it’s not just happening to me. **AI slop is becoming a dangerous vehicle for misinformation in general, in part because it can look incredibly real.**
That’s why it’s important that you don’t believe everything you see at first glance. When something comes from a page or source you don’t recognize, take a moment to double-check what you’re seeing or sharing.
For now, I’m incredibly grateful to be able to stay in touch with supporters like you by email and through my official social media channels—when you see something from me here, you can be sure it’s real!
Going forward, I’m going to continue to push for **common-sense guard rails** and **digital citizenship tools** to protect all of us from fake or violent content. And I need your help to do it.

Good afternoon,
I’m excited to share a special conversation with my friend Riley Gaines, and I wanted to personally invite you to join us.
**This** **evening at 7PM** , we’re hosting a LIVE mobile town hall conversation with Riley—one of the leading voices in the fight to protect women’s sports.
---
|
---
| |
Riley has been on the front lines of an issue that has quickly become a defining test of leadership and common sense across the country. What’s happening in women’s sports is just one example of a broader moment we’re living through—where basic truths are being challenged and too many leaders are unwilling to say what they know is right.
From my years covering sports, I can tell you this isn’t complicated. Protecting women’s sports is about fairness, safety, and preserving opportunities for the next generation of female athletes.
Together, we’ll talk about what’s happening, what’s at stake, and why Minnesota will play a critical role in the path to a Republican Senate majority. We’ll also discuss the broader fight here at home—defending parents’ rights, restoring accountability, and building a campaign that can win.
This will be a live, interactive conversation, and you’ll have the opportunity to listen in and participate.

Peter,

Watching movies with my daughter is one of my favorite memories from when she was growing up. We’d get cozy on the couch and settle in knowing we’d be laughing or crying together (or watching Legally Blonde for the millionth time) for the next two hours.

**These days, watching movies is a lot harder to fit in. Life on the campaign trail doesn’t leave much room for nights on the couch, and I wasn't able to see many of the Oscar-nominated movies this year.** Instead, I’ve been traveling across IA-01, meeting with folks, listening to their stories, and putting in the work to earn your trust. I may not have time for the silver screen lately, but let me tell you what I have been seeing:

Iowans are struggling. Grocery bills and gas prices are stretching families thin. Parents are worried about an education system that isn’t delivering for their kids. Too many people are finding that affordable healthcare is getting further and further out of reach.

**And what I hear, again and again, is that amidst all these struggles, the people of IA-01 are feeling deeply unheard by the one person in government who is supposed to look out for them: Mariannette Miller-Meeks. In her ads, she plays the role of a concerned leader, but all the editing and overacting in the world can't erase the damage her policies are having on our district.**

This is not what we deserve, not by a long shot.

In Congress, I will be a representative who will root for you and go to bat for your needs, even when Washington counts our district out. **[That is who I will be on day one and that is the type of leadership I hope you will support by making a donation to our campaign. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: James Talarico
body:
We will take Texas back if we do it together.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
My grandmother always told me: _“No te dejes.”_ Don't let them push you around. Fight back.
Today, I'm asking you to fight back — for all of Texas.
With record-breaking primary turnout, Texas Democrats made history. **I'm proud to be your Democratic nominee for Governor.** And I'm proud to share this ticket with a man I trust, a man who has been fighting the same fight I have, right here at home: **James Talarico, our Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate.**
If both James and I win, we can take back Texas this fall. Each of us needs to build a strong campaign that can reach all 254 counties of Texas. We are in this together — and we need you with us today.
**[Will you split a donation to support both of our campaigns right now?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260319_1_talarico.3aE8Vy&refcode=em20260319-780&amount=5&t=1&akid=780%2E299639%2EOawf-C)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260319_1_talarico.3aE8Vy&amount=5&refcode=em20260319-780&t=20&akid=780%2E299639%2EOawf-C)
Here's what I know about James: he's an eighth-generation Texan and a former middle school teacher who flipped a Trump district because he knew how to talk to people who'd been left behind. He's been standing beside me in Austin, fighting the billionaire mega-donors who have bought our state legislature and turned it against working people. **Now he's ready to take that fight to Washington.**
And that fight matters, because the biggest threat we face isn't each other — it's the people at the very top who spend billions to keep us angry and divided. Abbott, Cornyn, Paxton... _all of them_ AND their donors are counting on us to stay divided. **They are counting on Texas Democrats to run out of money, run out of fight, and run out of hope.**
__Not this time.__
James is running against a Republican Party that spent at least $75 million just to limp into a runoff — and they're still not done. Whether it's Cornyn or a freshly-impeached Paxton, James’s opponent will have super PAC money pouring in from day one. The Senate majority could come down to this race. It’s vital that James Talarico has the resources to build for the general election right now, and it’s vital that he win.
In our race, we start this general election in a dead heat. **A recent poll had my campaign within the margin of error against Greg Abbott.** Texas is in play. And my race for Governor is the kind of top-of-ticket campaign that lifts every Democrat on the ballot — including James.
That's why a split donation today is so powerful. When you invest in both of us, you're investing in a Texas where the whole ticket rises together. Every small donor, every neighbor, every Texan who is done being pushed around will play a part in this election.
Peter, if you believe in a Texas where every child learns in a great public school, where working families can afford to stay, where our government works for the people and not the powerful — then I need you to stand with me and James right now.
**[Split $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can between our campaigns today to help us flip Texas’s Senate seat _and_ defeat Greg Abbott.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260319_1_talarico.3aE8Vy&refcode=em20260319-780&amount=5&t=21&akid=780%2E299639%2EOawf-C)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260319_1_talarico.3aE8Vy&amount=5&refcode=em20260319-780&t=22&akid=780%2E299639%2EOawf-C)
James and I are both Texans. We both know this state can be better. And we both know that the only way we win is together.
_No te dejes._
With gratitude and determination
Gina Hinojosa
Democratic Nominee for Governor of Texas
P.S. — James and I are at the top of the ticket. When we run strong campaigns, every Democrat in Texas runs stronger. **[A donation split between us today isn't just helping two candidates](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260319_1_talarico.3aE8Vy&refcode=em20260319-780&amount=5&t=23&akid=780%2E299639%2EOawf-C)** — it's building the infrastructure to win Texas up and down the ballot.

And my race for Governor is the kind of top-of-ticket campaign that lifts every Democrat on the ballot — including James. That's why a split donation today is so powerful. When you invest in both of us, you're investing in a Texas where the whole ticket rises together. Every small donor, every neighbor, every Texan who is done being pushed around will play a part in this election. Peter, if you believe in a Texas where every child learns in a great public school, where working families can afford to stay, where our government works for the people and not the powerful — then I need you to stand with me and James right now. James and I are both Texans. We both know this state can be better. And we both know that the only way we win is together. No te dejes. The next step in the March to Pueblo!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7640af9c8f82/cobudgetupdate-14183436?e=8249791cac)

| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=c4c990887b&e=8249791cac)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi, Peter,Last week logged about 600 miles on the campaign trail attending candidate forums and Assemblies. I also participated remotely, or sent surrogate speakers or videos to places I couldn’t attend in person - [_**because participation matters**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=491b881359&e=8249791cac)[ _**.**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=88217e9969&e=8249791cac)_****_ Here are some highlights!
[](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=c0bd16fc83&e=8249791cac)**On Tuesday,** the Democratic Party of Colorado’s 6th House District hosted the second round of their candidate forums _Here’s The Ticket Pt. 2_ , featuring democratic candidates for Attorney General, Secretary of State and State Treasurer. I highlighted the importance of the Treasurer’s role in state government, how Colorado can create a path towards a public bank, support green banks, and systemically abolish TABOR! **Also on Tuesday,** Park and Pitkin Counties held their Assemblies. We sent materials, including a video, so we could participate.

**On Wednesday,** I attended the Jewish Community Relations Council (JCRC) Luncheon to show support of their community outreach efforts.
**On Thursday,** our campaign manager was at the Jeffco Candidates Meet and Greet for Assembly and I went to [Julie Gonzales’](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=01019e153f&e=8249791cac) Assembly Meet and Greet for delegates going to Assembly over the weekend. Our message at both: the importance of down ballot races and encouragement for everyone to participate actively in the Democratic process — this is YOUR state, and your voice matters!
[](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=24345d9800&e=8249791cac)
**Saturday** was the big campaign day. There were *sixteen* assemblies held across the state, pretty much simultaneously. I went to 5 personally, sent surrogates to 2 others, and was able to participate by sending video stump speeches to the rest. I wish I could have made it to more - rural Coloradans matter just as much as the city population centers, and I’m working hard to make sure I can represent all of us!
The Caucus and Assembly process is grueling, but I feel it’s so important to be present, connect with the party faithful, hear people’s concerns, hopes, and dreams, and participate to the best of my ability. I left my house at 7:15 am to make the first event and didn’t get home until over 12 hours later. We are still awaiting the full results to see which delegates are going to [Pueblo for the State Assembly on March 28th](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=0f5beb0921&e=8249791cac), where the Colorado Democratic Party will set the primary ballot for June 30th. [](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=863ee57e0c&e=8249791cac)Between now and then, we will be talking to state assembly delegates about my platform, my goals; how I see the Treasurer’s seat to be an opportunity for us all, and how important it is to have a state treasurer who understands the struggle of every day Coloradan and asking them to support my candidacy. _Especially today, in a country where the wealthy hold too much power and aren’t listening to the will of the people._ The Assembly process results are starting to show a stark primary choice between wealthy and well connected Democrats and progressive, grassroots candidates like me. It mirrors what’s happening on the national scene and impacting families across the country - while some are doing better than ever, many families are struggling to just stay afloat. The actions of a handful of millionaires and billionaires are hurting the majority of the country.
I’ve made it this far in the process because of you, and I am so eternally grateful. This campaign would not be possible without the support of every day people. I don’t take corporate checks, I will not be bought. [**Our campaign is powered by people like you.**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=29e6313e41&e=8249791cac)**Thank you.**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
If you could spare [**even just 7 dollars**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=5c2fef73bf&e=8249791cac) that would make a difference in if a wealthy career politician handles your tax payer dollars, or a public servant.

# [Sign: "Trump is dangerously unhinged and needs to be removed NOW"](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tafaab43e-90c6-4654-afcc-d581ebfebda4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb25621d2-dd85-48ad-9fe8-759b01d312a6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | **[Trump is an imminent danger to us all, and he needs to be removed by impeachment, 25th Amendment, or whatever legal means is available.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc72f5880-9fe7-485e-bc30-f754a592eca9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **Republicans, this means you too. You need to stop hiding on the sidelines, and work with Democrats to make this happen.** Trump has plunged us into a completely unnecessary war, he appears ready to use any weapon, and he has picked fights with just about every nation on Earth. Last week, I asked students at UT **_what they’d like to change about America._**
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67616?t=3&akid=240757%2E444211%2EWaOH1L)
These students had plenty to share: healthcare affordability, disparities in access to higher education, ICE, giving working-class citizens more of a voice, strengthening workers’ rights, cultural change and unity between parties, and so much more.
There’s a lot we need to fix in this country. The way we do it is by voting—and by making sure the people around us are registered and ready to show up.
That’s the work. We meet people where they are. We check their registration. If they’re not on the rolls, we get them registered. And then we stay in touch from now through November to make sure they vote—connecting what they care about to the power they’ve got in their hands: their ballot.

I remember Election Night 2014 like it was yesterday.

The party of supporters gathered to watch the votes roll in together. My hardworking staff tracking every precinct. Holding my wife Lisa’s hand as the results showed a much closer outcome than anticipated.

Before Election Night, everyone assumed our campaign had it in the bag. The polls were on our side. Some news outlets had even called this campaign “unbeatable.”

And then we came less than 20,000 votes away from losing. It took three days to learn the final results. I won by just 0.8% of the vote.

I tell you this story because I know we can’t take anything for granted. **And with so much on the line, we can’t sit back and hope for the best.**

**_THE GUARDIAN:_ Trump claims he has ‘absolute right’ to impose new tariffs after supreme court blow**
Peter,

Donald Trump thinks that as president, he's entitled to do whatever he wants. And right now, he's claiming that he has absolute authority over enacting new tariffs, even though the Supreme Court told him no.

Last year, Trump's illegal tariffs cost every American an additional $1,000. Grocery prices went up, resources for farmers became harder to get, and key trading partners looked elsewhere to get the goods they rely on, causing a massive impact on states' economies, including our own right here in Washington. And if kept in place, Trump's tariffs would cause Americans to lose another $1,300 this year.

The Supreme Court was right to say these tariffs are illegal. Congress is the only entity with the constitutional right to enact tariffs. But Trump is calling the Supreme Court "disloyal" and says they should always rule with him just because he's president. **That's not how democracy works.**

We have a system of checks and balances for a reason, and Trump doesn't just need to understand that; he needs to respect it. We're calling on this grassroots team to help us demand Trump listen to the Supreme Court and put an end to his illegal tariffs.

clean_body: Donald Trump thinks that as president, he's entitled to do whatever he wants. THE GUARDIAN: Trump claims he has ‘absolute right’ to impose new tariffs after supreme court blow Peter, Donald Trump thinks that as president, he's entitled to do whatever he wants. And right now, he's claiming that he has absolute authority over enacting new tariffs, even though the Supreme Court told him no. Last year, Trump's illegal tariffs cost every American an additional $1,000. Grocery prices went up, resources for farmers became harder to get, and key trading partners looked elsewhere to get the goods they rely on, causing a massive impact on states' economies, including our own right here in Washington. And if kept in place, Trump's tariffs would cause Americans to lose another $1,300 this year. The Supreme Court was right to say these tariffs are illegal. Congress is the only entity with the constitutional right to enact tariffs. But Trump is calling the Supreme Court "disloyal" and says they should always rule with him just because he's president. That's not how democracy works. We have a system of checks and balances for a reason, and Trump doesn't just need to understand that; he needs to respect it. We're calling on this grassroots team to help us demand Trump listen to the Supreme Court and put an end to his illegal tariffs. Thank you, Schrier HQ Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. This is one of the most competitive districts in the country, so we need your help to keep Kim in Congress. body:
The grassroots upset: How 3,320 volunteers pushed three child-focused measures onto Colorado’s ballot
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the PKC ballot measures making the 2026 ballot!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...**[ Gov. Jared Polis is backing a rewrite of the state’s 2024 AI law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after criticism it drove business away. Lawmakers also revisited a proposal to [require prison time for certain child sexual assault convictions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — but the bill failed in Senate Judiciary on a 4-3 vote, leaving most offenders still eligible for probation.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Legal and political fights are intensifying. More than 100 universities have [sued over the dismantling of NCAR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while federal officials defend the move, highlighting a broader federal-state clash. Former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters was [cleared of assault](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in a prison incident after claiming self-defense, and Jefferson County Schools [rejected a federal ruling on transgender sports policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), setting up a legal showdown. Meanwhile, three citizen-led initiatives on youth medical procedures, girls’ sports, and child trafficking have [qualified for the 2026 ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after a large volunteer effort, as ongoing concerns about the state’s economy persist with [reports of thousands of jobs leaving Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and renewed disputes over federal land policy.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Analysis of Operation Epic Fury indicates U.S. and Israeli actions have [weakened Iran’s missile systems, defenses, and proxy networks](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite warnings of broader instability, while the [departure of National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—amid allegations of leaks and criticism of the Iran conflict—has raised new concerns about internal security and leadership.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 19, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The grassroots upset: How 3,320 volunteers pushed three child-focused measures onto Colorado’s ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Three citizen-led ballot initiatives—focused on youth medical procedures, girls’ sports and child trafficking penalties—are now officially headed to Colorado’s November 2026 ballot, a result supporters say wasn’t supposed to happen.
That final step came this week, when Propositions 109 and 110 were certified, joining Proposition 108 after a campaign that gathered more than 500,000 signatures statewide.
For Erin Lee, executive director of Protect Kids Colorado, the moment lands as something bigger than a successful petition drive—it’s the end of a campaign many didn’t think would get this far.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado law allows probation for child sex assault: A third attempt to require prison time](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Bill targets probation for child sex assault convictions:** Colorado law currently allows probation in some child sexual assault cases, with about 70% of offenders avoiding prison, while SB26-111 would have required mandatory prison time for those convicted.
* **Third attempt follows repeated legislative roadblocks:** Efforts to eliminate probation for these crimes have failed twice in prior sessions, with sponsors alleging delays and opposition in committee prevented the bill from advancing despite bipartisan interest. The bill was killed again yesterday.
* **Debate centers on cost and public safety priorities:** The proposal would have cost about $3.5 million annually and sent roughly 56 additional offenders to prison each year, as supporters argue the change is needed to better protect children and ensure accountability.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Jeffco Schools Reject Federal Ruling On Transgender Sports Policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AXIOS DENVER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Jeffco rejects federal ruling on transgender sports policy:** Jefferson County Schools pushed back on a federal finding that allowing transgender students to compete in girls’ sports violates civil rights protections.
* **Dispute centers on definition of sex under federal law:** The conflict reflects a broader national debate, with federal policy defining sex based on biology while Colorado law protects gender identity and transgender participation.
* **Legal showdown likely between state and federal authorities:** District officials called the federal government’s legal arguments “erroneous,” setting up a potential court battle over how civil rights law applies in schools.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Framed as education, but tied to TABOR: Measure to keep surplus revenue advances](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | MARCH 17** _Colorado’s fight over spending limits is back at the Capitol, and this time it could end up in front of voters. The Senate Finance Committee voted 6–3 on March 12 to advance SB26-135, teeing up a 2026 vote on whether the state can keep revenue above the TABOR cap instead of sending it back as refunds._ __
**[From bill to emergency order: The election fight moves beyond Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 17** _Senate Republicans opened debate Tuesday on a bill they say will secure American elections. But inside that same fight, a second path is already taking shape—one that doesn’t run through Congress at all._
__
**[Colorado Must Reconsider the Imprisonment of Tina Peters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF | COMMENTARY | MARCH 17** _The case of former Mesa County Clerk and Recorder Tina Peters has become one of the most controversial legal and political episodes in modern Colorado election administration. But stripped of partisan rhetoric and competing narratives, the core issue before the public is far simpler—and far more troubling._
__

Derek, we recently asked you to take a survey to help us understand which issues mattered the most to you. On the one hand, we know they all matter – threats to free and fair elections in November, housing that’s too expensive, ICE and the National Guard deployed to our cities, rising oil and gas prices, and more. But it’s still helpful to hear directly from you about how you rank these and other challenges.

* **An overwhelming majority****** said inflation, the high cost of everyday items, is important but not _as_ important.
* More than 85% of you said it's "extremely important" to elect Democratic leaders like Chrissy who are fighting to hold the Trump administration accountable. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision...
body:
Hey, it’s
Mark Kelly.

Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run
for the Senate.

I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of
time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.

But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing
just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I
had to do something.

So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run
all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support,
we won that one, too.

I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and
defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the
greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be
here without your help.

We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The
President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got
the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now.

After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you
for more. But that’s what I need to do.

clean_body: Hey, it’s Mark Kelly. Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate. I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy. But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something. So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too. I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help. We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now. After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do. subject: They’re pissed off? Same.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
The establishment is angry that we’re coming for their seats. Our movement is working.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260319-1&t=1&akid=3264%2E587540%2EumQ0af)
Peter,
Last week, Axios reported that some longtime Democratic members of Congress are “pissed off” about the wave of young progressive primary challengers running against them.
Honestly? Good.
Because our generation is pissed off too.
We’re pissed off that Democrats keep losing winnable races while party leadership tells us to wait our turn.
We’re pissed off that Congress is full of asleep-at-the-wheel incumbents who have stopped fighting for their constituents while housing costs explode, student debt crushes millions, and health care grows more and more out of reach.
We’re pissed off that when young people step up to run, we’re told it’s somehow disrespectful, and that they’re tired of hearing our voices.
According to Axios, right now, **more than half a dozen House Democrats in their 70s and 80s are being outraised by younger challengers running to replace them.**
That’s not a coincidence, Peter. That’s a clear message.
And as I’ve said before, this was never about age. It’s about complacency and accountability. It’s about whether you’re still fighting for the people you’re supposed to represent.
Voters are hungry for leaders who understand the issues working people are facing right now. Leaders who have dealt with those problems firsthand.
Because when politicians hold onto power for decades, ignoring the needs of their constituents and blocking the next generation from stepping up, our Party and our democracy stagnate.
That’s why Leaders We Deserve exists. We back fearless young progressives who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo, who live the issues on the ballot, and who are ready to fight like hell because they know the stakes are far too high to play it safe. And we do it without taking a dime of corporate money.
And listen, yes, some establishment Democrats are angry about it. But guess what, you can either be liked by everyone and do nothing or you can be hated by a few and actually do something. After 2024 we don’t have the option but to do something radically different.
But change has never come from people in power deciding they’re ready to give it up. It comes from people rising up and demanding something better.
**[If you’re ready to elect the next generation of progressive fighters who will finally fight for working people, will you pitch in $5 right now to support the work of Leaders We Deserve?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260319_1_generational.0jZ9hV&refcode=em20260319-3264&amount=5&t=2&akid=3264%2E587540%2EumQ0af)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

subject: My favorite part of this job
body:
There’s nothing better than being back in the district

| |
---
Hi friend, One of the best parts of serving in Congress is coming home to the district. Spending time with neighbors. Hearing directly from families. Visiting small businesses. Talking with community leaders about what’s working and what still needs attention. These conversations matter more than anything that happens in DC. Representing this district is the honor of a lifetime It is also a massive responsibility, and I never take it for granted. Every story you share reminds me why I fought to get here. When I see how a policy hits a New Jersey family or worker, I carry that reality back to Washington. It dictates the questions I ask, the bills I write, and the fights I take on. Our community deserves a representative who is present, who listens, and who isn't afraid to speak truth to power. But staying in this fight means winning an election where extremist Republicans will spend millions to defeat me. They don't want a representative for New Jersey; they want a crony who will take orders from MAGA leadership and rubber-stamp their agenda. **[Don’t let outside money drown out our voice. clean_body: There’s nothing better than being back in the district | | Hi friend, One of the best parts of serving in Congress is coming home to the district. Spending time with neighbors. Hearing directly from families. Visiting small businesses. Talking with community leaders about what’s working and what still needs attention. These conversations matter more than anything that happens in DC. Representing this district is the honor of a lifetime It is also a massive responsibility, and I never take it for granted. Every story you share reminds me why I fought to get here. When I see how a policy hits a New Jersey family or worker, I carry that reality back to Washington. It dictates the questions I ask, the bills I write, and the fights I take on. Our community deserves a representative who is present, who listens, and who isn't afraid to speak truth to power. But staying in this fight means winning an election where extremist Republicans will spend millions to defeat me. They don't want a representative for New Jersey; they want a crony who will take orders from MAGA leadership and rubber-stamp their agenda. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. name: Roy Cooper
subject: I’m running against Trump’s handpicked candidate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Roy Cooper for North Carolina
body:
We can flip this seat from red to blue for the first time since 2008, but far-right Republican PACs and megadonors will spend hundreds of millions to stop us.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=758%2E124072%2EUh0CN5)
| | | |
---
Peter,

Earlier this month, I won the Democratic nomination for North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat. I’m officially running against Republican Michael Whatley, a far-right Big Oil lobbyist and President Trump’s handpicked candidate.
As our general election campaign gets going, I’m thinking about how grateful I am for the support of folks like you who got me here. **Now is the time to stand up and fight for our future – and I am ready. But I need you with me.**
**_[Just this week, a brand-new poll was released that showed my opponent and me statistically tied, so it’s more important than ever to show the strength of this grassroots movement. Will you chip in $5 today to help us win the biggest Senate race in the country, break the GOP’s hold on Washington and return power to the people?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7159?t=7&akid=758%2E124072%2EUh0CN5)_**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7091?t=8&akid=758%2E124072%2EUh0CN5)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7092?t=9&akid=758%2E124072%2EUh0CN5)
---

---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7090?t=12&akid=758%2E124072%2EUh0CN5)
_A picture of my wife, Kristin, and me at my primary election night party!_
I didn’t plan to run for federal office. I wanted to serve North Carolina from right here at home. But when I look at what’s happening across the country, I know I can’t leave things as they are for my daughters or for yours.
So long as Trump’s extreme allies are in power, there is no path to accountability or restraint. Just more chaos, division and attacks on our fundamental freedoms.
**To set our nation back on course, we must regain Senate control – and that starts by winning in North Carolina.** We can flip this seat from red to blue for the first time since 2008, but far-right Republican PACs and megadonors will spend hundreds of millions to stop us.
**_[Whether they succeed depends on people like you, Peter. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help us make sure we have the critical resources we need to win?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7159?t=13&akid=758%2E124072%2EUh0CN5)_**
Thank you for everything.

Roy
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

We won our primary election, and I am proud to be Illinois’ Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate!

This victory was powered by grassroots supporters like you. Together, we overcame more than $10 million in MAGA special interest spending — and we won.

But if this primary showed us anything, it’s that MAGA Republicans are determined to stake their claim in Illinois — and this Senate seat is their first target.

I wish I didn’t have to ask so soon after such an exciting win, but I’m counting on strong grassroots support to defeat my Republican opponent and prove that their playbook won’t work here.

clean_body: Illegal actions → legal consequences. | | Friend, There’s been a lot of debate in Washington about what to do about ICE. Some Democrats still talk about reforming the agency: new leadership, new rules, better oversight. But after everything we’ve seen over the past year, that’s simply not realistic. ICE is beyond repair. It should be abolished. But abolishing the agency alone isn’t enough. There has to be accountability for the people who broke the law. The masked agents who broke the law while carrying out these abuses should be prosecuted. You can’t enforce the law if you think you’re above it, and we’ve seen too many ICE officers act exactly that way — refusing to identify themselves, intimidating the communities they’re supposed to serve, kidnapping and even killing American citizens with a sense of impunity. This isn’t just dangerous for our communities. It undermines trust in our democratic system. The only way to rebuild that trust is to start with accountability. Then we can build the system our country actually needs: one that encourages people to come here legally, provides a clear pathway to citizenship, and enforces the law in a way that reflects American values. My story is all too common
| Hi Friend, this email’s going to be a little longer because I want to make sure you know who I am and why I’m running. And yes, I am going to ask you for your support at the end, so **[if you’re short on time, you can click here to pitch in now.](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-mar26.Ye988L&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_031926_B1_Story&t=2&akid=5941%2E196590%2E9bFNiu)** My story started in the heart of Milwaukee in the 53206 zip code, Wisconsin’s poorest and the nation’s most incarcerated. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-mar26.Ye988L&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_031926_B1_Story&t=3&akid=5941%2E196590%2E9bFNiu) My grandfather moved to Milwaukee after serving during World War II. He worked in a factory, and there were thousands of people just like him whose jobs paid the bills and helped build a comfortable life for a family. **Those jobs got sent overseas – all because of corporate greed.** Wealthy billionaires and huge corporations have been destabilizing our communities just to line their own pockets. **This story is not unique. It’s not about left or right or even urban or rural. It’s happening more and more all across Wisconsin. Corporations are buying up farms and houses and leaving it on us to bear the burden.** The turning point in my life came for me in high school, when I lost my first friend to gun violence. As I got older, I lost more friends and saw more of my community struggling with similar tragedies. I recognized that this is happening too often in our communities – that we were experiencing far too much violence without enough systemic support. And if the government can be quick to respond to the needs of the wealthiest individuals in this country, **we should be even quicker to support the people who need our help the most.** These are the people who are ignored by our government time and time again. **[It’s past time for that story to end — and as governor, I’ll deliver a bold vision for generational change here in Wisconsin. body:
After Five Years of Hiding from Republican Voters, Will Cassidy Finally Show Up?

| | |
---
| | | | [|

| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** March 19, 2026Katherine@julialetlow.com
**LETLOW ACCEPTS MOON GRIFFON DEBATE, CHALLENGES CASSIDY TO JOIN** _After Five Years of Hiding from Republican Voters, Will Cassidy Finally Show Up?_
**Baton Rouge, La.** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow today confirmed she will appear live on the Moon Griffon Show on April 28 for a debate and challenged Senator Bill Cassidy and Treasurer John Fleming to join her before Louisiana Republican voters.
_“Moon Griffon reaches the heart of Louisiana’s conservative grassroots, and that is exactly the audience that should hear this debate. I will be there on April 28. The question is whether Bill Cassidy will show up,”_**said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.**_“I look forward to speaking directly to Louisiana Republicans about the future of our state, my conservative record, and the clear choice in this race between a Trump-endorsed conservative and a career politician who has spent five years running from his vote to convict President Trump.”_
Congresswoman Letlow made clear that a Republican primary debate should take place on a platform that actually reaches Republican voters, and now it is on Cassidy to accept the debate.
_“Congresswoman Letlow has accepted a debate on a platform trusted by the Republican voters who will decide this race. If Senator Cassidy is serious, he should accept. If he refuses, that tells you all you need to know,”_ **said** **Katherine Thordahl, Communications Director for Julia Letlow for Louisiana**.
The Moon Griffon debate will give Louisiana Republican primary voters a direct opportunity to hear from the candidates in an unfiltered setting on a platform trusted by conservatives across the state.
Bill Cassidy voted to convict President Trump. Julia Letlow is running with President Trump’s complete and total endorsement. On May 16, Louisiana Republicans will decide which candidate they trust to represent them in the United States Senate.

| | **Modesto Police Officers Association Endorses Alexandra Duarte for State Senate**
---
| MODESTO, CA — Alexandra Duarte, Republican candidate for California State Senate, today announced the endorsement of the Modesto Police Officers Association, adding another respected public safety voice to the growing coalition behind her campaign. The endorsement builds on Duarte’s expanding support from law enforcement, local leaders, and grassroots conservatives across the region, and reinforces her campaign’s strong focus on public safety, accountability, and unwavering support for the men and women who put on the badge to protect California communities. The Modesto Police Officers Association represents officers serving on the front lines in one of the Central Valley’s most important communities. Its endorsement signals strong confidence in Duarte’s commitment to stand with law enforcement and push back against the failed Sacramento policies that have weakened public safety, empowered criminals, and left too many families feeling less secure. “As crime rises and confidence in state leadership falls, voters are looking for leaders who will stand firmly for safer streets and stronger communities,” Duarte said. “I’m honored to have the support of the Modesto Police Officers Association and proud to stand with those who risk their lives every day to keep our neighborhoods safe.” Duarte is running for State Senate to restore accountability in Sacramento, support law enforcement, protect local communities, and fight for a safer, stronger California. ###

Salon: Trump is going all in on the SAVE America Act. It could make voting harder for millions [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031926_2&amount=25]
Folks, we've been warning you about voter suppression bills like the SAVE Act, the MEGA Act, and the SAVE America Act since they were introduced, since they represent a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote.
President Trump is, unsurprisingly, all in and refusing to sign any other legislation until this suppressive legislation passes. The SAVE America Act would require Americans to register to vote in person with documentary proof of citizenship — in most cases a birth certificate or passport. It narrowly passed the House in February, a week after Trump called for Republicans to “ nationalize voting .”
If the SAVE America Act were passed, it would mark the first time in U.S. history that Congress restricted the right to vote , according to Michael Waldman, president and CEO of the nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031926_2&amount=35]
It's simple: With Trump focused on re-litigating the 2020 election, this legislation would give him all the power he would need to take federal control of the upcoming midterms .
These bills are a sweeping attack on voting rights. The SAVE America Act could:
* Impose a strict photo ID requirement to vote
* Create a centralized voter surveillance system in every state
* Mandate constant voter roll purges, gutting the “Motor Voter” law that expanded access to voter registration
* Bar states from counting ballots that arrive after Election Day
* Ban universal mail voting, in which states mail a ballot to all registered voters
* Bar the federal funding for voter registration by outside groups
* Unleash lawsuits against election officials
Estimates said the SAVE America Act could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities. The fact that 217 members of the House voted to pass it and it's now been brought up for debate in the Senate is highlighting how perilously close we are to severe damage to our democracy.
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for voting. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE America Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031926_2&amount=35]

Back to Michael Waldman, president and CEO of the nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice:
“ Congress, when it has gotten involved, has worked to expand the vote, to stop abuse of power. If this law passes, it would be the most restrictive voting bill ever passed by Congress. To turn back the clock rather than advancing our democracy — that has not happened before. ”
He's not alone. Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School and a leading historian of voting rights said this about the SAVE Act (the original version of the SAVE America Act):
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this . It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
This bill is nothing less than an all-out partisan assault on our fundamental right to vote . If made law, this bill would codify MAGA's power for decades to come, invalidating millions of eligible voters and ending our democracy for a generation or longer.
We can't sit back, Team, and watch our fundamental right to vote die. Fight back against opponents of voting rights and their suppressive bills with $35 or whatever you can before it's too late >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031926_2&amount=35]

body:
With the Voting Rights Act in the balance, the future of our democracy will depend on us.
|
---

**Peter, any day now, the Supreme Court will decide the fate of the Voting Rights Act. The _Callais vs. Louisiana_ decision may be a defining event for our democracy.**
It's no exaggeration to call the VRA the cornerstone of fair representation in America — it is the crown jewel of the civil rights movement.
That’s why it’s so appalling to witness powerful forces try to tear it down, stripping away the right of communities across the country to be free from discrimination.
The unfortunate truth is, these aren’t the problems of a bygone America. These are issues we are dealing with today.
Throughout this redistricting crisis, we’ve witnessed states actively trying to take voting power away from communities of color. What’s more, we know that anti-democracy forces are eagerly awaiting this Supreme Court ruling in the hopes that it will justify them ripping up fair maps. Just like Jim Crow-era leaders, they want to skew their maps to take away millions of voters’ ability to influence our country’s future.
**Regardless of how the Supreme Court rules, we have our work cut out for us. **
**Here’s what gives me hope: Generations before us have fought fights just like the ones we face. Even against odds that felt insurmountable,_they’ve shown us these fights can be won._**
Their fight for justice and progress in this country is the foundation we build off of, and the legacy we carry on. We must continue the unfinished march.
Those who try to prevent the arc of the moral universe from bending towards justice might win small battles — but they will fail in the long run because people like you will never stop fighting for our democracy.
Let me be clear, the months ahead will be hard and the stakes are enormous. But if there's enough of us and if we are focused and determined, we can — and I believe we will — prevail.

It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction. It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC. But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11. As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you. I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great. We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win. So now we're forced to rebuild. The Democrat Machine is ALREADY crushing us in fundraising, ALREADY outspending us in key races, and ALREADY building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections. At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable. So here's my final pitch to you: I understand that's ambitious. But if that's what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it's a no-brainer. I'll do what it takes to win. Do you think you can help us get there? Whether it's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up: , you've probably heard bits and pieces of my story at this point. If my humble beginnings taught me anything, it's to never give up, never surrender, and never go down without a fight. That's why I'm partnering with Steve Scalise to help lay the critical groundwork we need to win. Regardless, it's an honor to fight alongside you. But after a historic court victory for fair voting maps, we now have a real opportunity to send one to Washington this November. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Nate entered this race with a major endorsement from Senator Bernie Sanders because he has already shown he's a leader with integrity. He’s not a business-as-usual Democrat — he speaks truth to power, takes on the political establishment, and treats Republican attacks as proof that he's doing something right. That’s the kind of bold leadership JanePAC believes in. As a Utah State Senator, Nate fought to protect the Great Salt Lake from an ecological collapse that would threaten the health of millions of people across the region. He's pushed to accelerate wind, solar, and geothermal energy development across the Intermountain West. He's championed grid modernization and expanded electric vehicle infrastructure. And he's stood firm against attempts to fast-track dirty energy production in his state. Bottom line: Nate’s an incredible leader, and he needs the support of this grassroots movement to make history this November. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = In solidarity, Jane Fonda = | Follow along: | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
Your critical gift of $25, $50, $100 or more will help NCLU expose a corrupt government — and fight for veterans who've been left with nothing.
NCLU just won a historic and critically important victory: The court just granted our motion to lift the protective order that shrouded most J6 discovery in a veil of secrecy.

| Dear Patriot,
[](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9) Your critical gift of **[**$25, $50, $100 or more**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9)** will help NCLU expose a corrupt government — and fight for veterans who've been left with nothing. Let me tell you about Travis. He was a decorated U.S. Army veteran with 14 years of service. Six years from retirement. A man who had given everything to his country. **Then corrupt officials in West Virginia decided to destroy him.** Why? Because Travis's ex-wife didn't want to share custody of their daughter. And she just happened to be the stepdaughter of a local judge... and the mistress of a high-ranking county law enforcement officer. They coerced a false statement. They manufactured a conviction. They had Travis thrown out of the military and stripped of his security clearance. His career — gone. His retirement — gone. His ability to fight for his daughter — gone. **They thought they'd buried him.** ******[Donate Now](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9) ** But they didn't count on the National Constitutional Law Union. I'm John Pierce — Harvard Law graduate, former editor of the Harvard Law Review, and Army veteran. I was a partner at Quinn Emanuel, the #1 business litigation firm in America. I built a law firm with a $700 million litigation portfolio. **I walked away from all of it to fight for Americans like Travis.** On Halloween 2025, NCLU filed a Writ of Coram Nobis on Travis's behalf — one of the rarest legal tools in existence, used only three times in West Virginia history. What happened next shocked everyone. EVERY judge in that circuit court recused themselves. **Every. Single. One.** A fair, outside judge was brought in to handle the case. Then came the bombshell... **A special prosecutor has been assigned** — working with a West Virginia State Police investigator into the crimes alleged in our filing. **Two circuit court judges are now under criminal investigation.** Along with several others. And the probe is growing by the day. The Governor of West Virginia is watching this case. **Courts across the nation are watching this case.** **[****](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9)******[Donate Now](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9)**** The final evidentiary hearing is scheduled **for April 2**. I'm going in personally — _pro hac vice_ — to stand beside Travis in that courtroom. [**But I need your help to get there**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9). Travel. Hotel. A local attorney to formally admit me to argue the case. These are real costs with a real deadline. **Patriot** , NCLU has no billionaire donors. No war chest. We have patriots like you — Americans who believe no corrupt official should be above the law. Please **[**donate $25, $50, $100 or more**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9)** right now to help NCLU finish what we started. Justice is within reach. Don't let it slip away. For Justice,
John M. Pierce
Harvard Law '00, NCLU Founder
**P.S.** Patriot, two circuit court judges are under criminal investigation because NCLU refused to abandon a veteran who had nothing left. The April 2 hearing could change everything — not just for Travis, but for every American facing corrupt local government. Please **[**donate $25, $50, $100 or more**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9)** immediately. Thank you. [Donate Now](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-A/s3tdf0d31f9)

Hello! My name is Tyler Murset. I was born in Provo, grew up in Hurricane, and currently live in St. George. I graduated high school in 1997 and then served a Spanish-speaking mission in Southern California for two years. After my mission, I graduated from Dixie State College with a bachelor's degree in Business Administration. I later received my MBA from Western Governors University.
I married my lovely wife, Monica, in 2004, and we have three great kids who make me proud every day. For the past 15 years, I've worked in our local school district in purchasing, including the last nine years as the Warehouse Manager.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/20c336c9-dc86-43cf-b8e9-50dd0fb41022?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Mursets
Are you bored yet?
I'll get to the point.
Our representatives (including Celeste Maloy, whom I'm running against) do not represent us. Our own supposedly Republican representatives pass laws that bypass our caucus system (SB54) and allow outside interests to redraw district boundaries (Prop. 4 with new lines selected unconstitutionally by a judge), giving Democrats a potential U.S. House seat with **no real opposition from our state representatives**.
What about our voting systems and voter ID? Don't get me started.
**I feel backstabbed.** **I feel unheard.** Don't you?
Whose side are these people on? Not ours. That's for sure.
For this reason I've created [VotingAct](https://substack.com/redirect/2e17ac30-fc34-4927-89a9-45e890d9fdbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)1. An app that allows **U.S. citizens** who are **registered voters** to vote on bills in Congress. **I pledge to vote with the majority of you in my district on those bills.**
The app authenticates users via valid ID, a selfie, and voter registration, _all of which must correlate._
The app then pulls in all the bills from Congress daily and allow authenticated users to debate and ultimately vote on them using a double-blind, encrypted system.
Votes are publicly viewable but anonymized. Not even the app's administrators know how you vote--only that you voted. You can track your own vote and verify that it was counted correctly.
Vote tallies are directly compared to how representatives vote, so you can instantly see when they go rogue.
That won't happen with me. **I will vote with you.**
Please join me in this movement to get our representatives to actually represent us.
Visit my website at [https://votingact.com](https://substack.com/redirect/2e17ac30-fc34-4927-89a9-45e890d9fdbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
We will have a livestream this Friday evening at 7 p.m. on [https://votingact.com](https://substack.com/redirect/2e17ac30-fc34-4927-89a9-45e890d9fdbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where I can meet you, walk through the details and answer your questions.
Talk to you soon!
Tyler Murset

Our own supposedly Republican representatives pass laws that bypass our caucus system (SB54) and allow outside interests to redraw district boundaries (Prop. 4 with new lines selected unconstitutionally by a judge), giving Democrats a potential U.S. House seat with no real opposition from our state representatives. What about our voting systems and voter ID? Don't get me started. I feel backstabbed. I feel unheard. Don't you? Whose side are these people on? Not ours. That's for sure. For this reason I've created . An app that allows U.S. citizens who are registered voters to vote on bills in Congress. I pledge to vote with the majority of you in my district on those bills. The app authenticates users via valid ID, a selfie, and voter registration, all of which must correlate. The app then pulls in all the bills from Congress daily and allow authenticated users to debate and ultimately vote on them using a double-blind, encrypted system. Votes are publicly viewable but anonymized. Not even the app's administrators know how you vote--only that you voted. You can track your own vote and verify that it was counted correctly. Vote tallies are directly compared to how representatives vote, so you can instantly see when they go rogue. That won't happen with me. I will vote with you. Please join me in this movement to get our representatives to actually represent us. Visit my website at . We will have a livestream this Friday evening at 7 p.m. on , where I can meet you, walk through the details and answer your questions. Talk to you soon! Tyler Murset 1 In app stores soon. A mobile-friendly web version minus the user authentication module is available for all to view now. | | | | | (C) 2026 Tyler Murset 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This bill is deeply disturbing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Trump said passing the SAVE Act will, “guarantee the midterms.”

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2818%2E4032634%2EZnQVIF)
---
Donald Trump is trying to stop American citizens from voting. Why? Because he knows his agenda is unpopular and Republicans can’t win based on what he’s doing, so he wants to rig the election by picking his own voters. That’s what the SAVE Act is all about. Don’t let Trump and the Republicans in Congress fool you. They’ll say things like, _"You should have to show ID to vote just like you do to buy a beer."_ But this is not an ordinary voter ID bill. This is not a bill that says everybody has to show either a driver's license or student ID to vote. This is a way to keep American citizens from voting. I'll give you an example: If this bill passes, then in 45 of 50 states, your driver's license won’t count as valid ID. Let’s say you’re a married woman who lives in Massachusetts. And let’s say that when you got married, you took your husband’s name. Well, when you go to the polls to vote, you can't register by showing them your updated driver’s license. Why? Because Massachusetts is one of the 45 states where a driver’s license doesn’t prove citizenship. So you bring along your birth certificate? Now can you vote? Nope. Your birth certificate is still under your maiden name. Yes, you can use a passport, if you have one. But remember that fewer than half of all Americans have a passport and it costs $165 to get one — and takes a month or two, if everything is working on time. No passport and no birth certificate that matches your driver’s license? Well, Trump and the Republicans say you’re out of luck. **And that’s just one example of how this bill will actually make it harder for Americans to vote.** [**Look, Republicans are pulling every lever they can to wage an assault on our democracy and cling onto their power. We can’t — and won’t let them. We need to demonstrate that the American people are outright rejecting the SAVE Act. Please add your name to say you do not support this legislation.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3509?t=8&akid=2818%2E4032634%2EZnQVIF) Here’s another deeply disturbing thing about this bill: it would require states to hand over sensitive information about voters to Trump’s Department of Homeland Security, so that some shadowy guys can do whatever they want with it. Maybe they take you off the voter rolls. Maybe they use that information for something else. No one knows what will happen. This is an agency whose former leader Kristi Noem said, just a few weeks ago, “we need to...make sure that we have the right people voting.” Guess who's going to get swept off the voter rolls? People that the Republicans think are likely to vote Democratic. So, sweep off Black people, sweep off Brown people, sweep off women, sweep off students, sweep off people in precincts who voted Democratic last time, sweep off people that you think might vote Democratic in the upcoming election. This Trump bill is Jim Crow 2.0. Noncitizen voting is extremely rare. Republicans know that. They’ve seen the data: Voter roll audits in Georgia prior to the 2024 election found only 20 registered noncitizens out of 8.2 million registered voters, or 0.00024%. A 2024 Michigan audit found only 16 noncitizen votes out of 5.7 million votes, or 0.00028%. So why do they want to do this? Lucky for us, Republicans have been saying the quiet part out loud. Republicans in Congress know they’re in deep trouble for the midterms unless they can rig the rules and pick their own voters. Donald Trump even said it himself: he said passing the SAVE Act will, “guarantee the midterms.” Because the Republicans know, and Donald Trump knows, that the policies they are shoving through right now are wildly unpopular. So while Trump and Republicans try to spread conspiracies and lie about the SAVE Act, it’s important that each and every one of us stays focused on what the Trump administration is really doing — and fight back. [**This is worth fighting for — and I’m going to give this fight all that I’ve got. Add your name if you’re with me: The American people say NO to passing the SAVE Act.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3509?t=9&akid=2818%2E4032634%2EZnQVIF) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

# [Trump's FCC is now threatening TV stations for reporting facts. For real](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb8976457-1e0a-497f-b874-af519893e822/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

FCC Chair Brendan Carr is [warning](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc4e384df-7f06-4cf3-b4f2-93d876c5fd2f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) broadcasters that if they air “fake news” about the war with Iran—meaning anything that doesn’t match Trump’s rosy spin—they could face consequences when their licenses come up for renewal. **Let that sink in. The government is threatening to punish news outlets for reporting the truth.** Because when you can’t control reality... you try to control what people are allowed to hear about it. This isn’t a gray area. This isn’t complicated. **It’s censorship.** The First Amendment isn’t optional. [But we need to defend it](https://default.salsalabs.org/T35461432-1950-4789-8512-c50d7ee5d86c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127671704/608829863/-436958700?refcode=EM_F_260319Split_N_HS_90DO_10_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzQxMzkwMy1kZjIzLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U4iTZOIoRL-iwkWnEgfJ-sbZhMsX2I-ysFph2CYldrw=) **I bet you still remember getting handed the keys to your first car, Peter.** I sure do.

That old, used Cutlass Supreme? It meant more to me than just freedom. It meant I had a piece of Michigan. The Michigan that helped build this country. The Michigan that shaped me.

I always knew I wanted to spend my life fighting for the people and communities I love here in Michigan. When the Great Recession hit and the American car industry faced extinction, I wanted to step up and do something for my state. So I answered the call to serve as chief of staff to President Obama’s Auto Rescue initiative, and we helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs and stabilize our economy.

Fast forward to today, and Michigan jobs are once again at risk, this time from Donald Trump and his reckless tariffs – which are threatening the jobs of tens of thousands of hardworking Michiganders.

**Trump said he “couldn’t care less” if auto prices rise.**

Well, as someone who has spent my time in Congress fighting for Michigan jobs, Michigan families, and Michigan workers, _I couldn’t care more._

Here’s the truth about Washington right now: They’re not working.
House Republicans just wrapped up their big policy retreat — where they were supposed to craft an agenda for 2026.
And what did they come up with to lower costs for families? Not much.
No real plan. No concrete proposals. No timeline to help families struggling with higher prices. Just more political theater from leaders like Mike Johnson, Lauren Boebert, and their colleagues in the chaos caucus.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email?]

That’s their strategy. Not solving problems, lowering costs, or strengthening the middle class. Just noise.
I’m running for Congress because the people who feed, fuel, and care for this country deserve something better than performance politics. They deserve a representative who shows up ready to work — not someone auditioning for the next cable news segment.
But here’s the reality: national Republicans know this seat is critical to keeping their majority. They’ll pour money into this race to protect Boebert and the chaos she represents.
